status_note: the pin is the head of the fork branch claude/project-thread-md70sq (moeendres-png/mage, PR #72, fast-forwarded into the candidate line claude/xmage-mp-candidate-20260929): the v13 pin 90f5c4d3f8 plus four commits that build the 21 Commander precon cards the engine did not know for real, each with Mage.Tests cases (fifteen Doctor Who cards: Susan Foreman, Missy, The Foretold Soldier, The Pandorica, Cybership, Cyber Conversion, Death in Heaven, Don't Blink, Doomsday Confluence, The Cyber-Controller, Psychic Paper, Rassilon the War President, River Song's Diary, The Moment, The War Doctor; Feather, Radiant Arbiter; Immortal Obligation; Eye of Duskmantle; Desert Warfare; Exchange of Words; Space Beleren), plus three fixes: the untap cost of Sage of the Maze (an untapped Gate is required) and two object orders that follow the insertion order (SacrificeAllEffect, Chaos Mutation). Owner's go: see owner_go. The native maven.yml run on the exact commit is bound under native_qualification; the Lab bridge suite stays PENDING until the XMage Full Game Conformance run on the repin branch is bound; current_boundary keeps its repin-time status REQUALIFICATION_REQUIRED.
